The change registers classic `mort` ligature subtables and routes their state tables to the new `StateHeader` reader. When the component-table byte length is odd, that reader adjusts `ligatureOffset` down by one and reads a whole number of component words rather than rejecting the odd length. Thus, for some such subtables with otherwise compatible data, decompilation can now return a table instead of raising an exception.
